note: The script asks for the hook text, the name super, one number pop (20 to 21) and two top text lines (kind of boring / kind of fun). Every other row is captions only. The end card is typed until the LearnFresh logo is in the repo.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: Not really a sports fan. Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on. Top third. Out at 00:03. Name super at 00:03 for 2 s, lower left above the captions: Lilah H. / 7th grade.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: Not really a sports fan. Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on. Top third. Out at 00:03. Name super at 00:03 for 2 s, lower left above the captions: Lilah H. / 7th grade.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:03 for 2 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line <7th grade> under it.

mg.title: Number pop
mg.cue: Number pop at the moment she says it: 20 to 21, small label under it the last match. Top band, 2 s.
mg.use: Pop it at the moment she says “20 to 21” as it is said, top band, 2 s.

mg.title: Before
mg.cue: Top text when she says it: kind of boring, then kind of fun. Each 2 s, top band. Captions stay on.
mg.use: Put it on at the moment she says “kind of boring” and hold 2 s, in the top band. Captions stay on.

mg.title: Now
mg.cue: Top text when she says it: kind of boring, then kind of fun. Each 2 s, top band. Captions stay on.
mg.use: Put it on at the moment she says “kind of fun” and hold 2 s, in the top band. Captions stay on.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card lines: <q>Donate to Learn Fresh</q> / <q>learnfresh.org</q>. No logo before this card.
mg.src: No LearnFresh logo file in the repo yet (brand kit is in Airtable). The name is typed until the logo is added to endcards/learn-fresh/.
mg.use: This is the end card. Put it at 00:31 after the last line and hold it to the end.
